name: Plain Card Data 1
definition: Sensible data associated with the payment card performing the transaction.

PAN.name: PAN
PAN.definition: Primary Account Number (PAN) of the card, or card number.

CardSequenceNumber.name: Card Sequence Number
CardSequenceNumber.definition: Identify a card inside a set of cards with the same card number (PAN).

EffectiveDate.name: Effective Date
EffectiveDate.definition: Date as from which the card can be used.

ServiceCode.name: Service Code
ServiceCode.definition: Services attached to the card, as defined in ISO 7813.

TrackData.name: Track Data
TrackData.definition: Magnetic track or equivalent payment card data.

CardSecurityCode.name: Card Security Code
CardSecurityCode.definition: Card security code (CSC) associated with the card performing the transaction.
